scenarios.name: ECMWF SEAS5 seasonal ensemble
scenarios.probability_semantics: ensemble members, skill not evaluated for Mekong
assumptions: First up to 180 days use SEAS5 Tmax/Tmin/rain ensemble members; remaining horizon spliced onto POWER climatology analog years.
Dew point, radiation and wind needed by FAO-56 come from the same analog-year day throughout; cross-variable coherence is approximate.
Members paired deterministically with cycling analog years; no evaluated skill or calibrated probabilities.

assumptions: Monthly Tmax delta: mean 2041–2050 minus mean 2025–2034; precipitation multiplied by monthly future/base ratio.

Tmin, dew point, radiation and wind remain from the analog-year day (tasmax/pr only).

reasons.text: Nhu cầu tưới trung vị giảm ~694 mm (~6,940 m³/ha) so với hiện tại trên cùng 24 năm lịch sử NASA POWER.
Trong các năm khô nhất, giảm ~716 mm nước tưới so với hiện tại.
Giảm ~14 ngày nắng nóng (≥ ngưỡng cây) ở giai đoạn nhạy cảm.

ev_region_calendar.source: regions.json: MARD/Cuc Trong trot cropping calendars for Mekong Delta (Đông Xuân Nov-Dec, Hè Thu Mar-May, Thu Đông Jul-Aug)
limitations: Windows are widened to guarantee a 3-crop rice sequence: latest sowing + 110 d + 10 d turnaround fits the next window's end; actual local calendars vary by province and flood/salinity status.
Upland crops in Hè Thu face rain onset in May; their duration must be checked per sowing date.

ev_salinity_season.source: MARD/SIWRP salinity intrusion reports 2016, 2020, 2024; MRC Mekong salinity intrusion studies
limitations: Dates are multi-year typical; actual onset and peak shift with El Nino years and upstream discharge.
Applies to coastal zones only; inland sites have negligible risk.
Skill not evaluated for Mekong; no calibrated probabilities.
Not bias corrected; regional estimate, not field observation.
Members with incomplete/invalid windows (including negative precipitation in the API) omitted, never filled with zero.
Temperature/precipitation members spliced onto POWER analog years after ~180 days; dew point, radiation and wind always from analog days.

ev_nex_cmip6.source: NASA NEX-GDDP-CMIP6 v2.0 via NCCS NCSS
limitations: 2041–2050 minus 2025–2034 monthly Tmax delta and precipitation ratio applied to POWER analog days.
Only Tmax and precipitation adjusted; Tmin, dew point, radiation and wind unchanged.
SSPs have no assigned probability; not weather forecasts.
Modeled regional river discharge, not salinity or canal ECw; river cell requires local verification.
Trailing 7-day mean vs same calendar window in available 2001–2020 years; anomaly is not a calibrated salinity threshold.
Recent discharge may be modeled forecast data; only days through retrieval/as_of used.
